key_highlights: ASX closed the week lower as traders priced in further RBA rate hikes following a blowout US jobs report and sticky inflation narrative (#50, #14)
Australian banks forecast the largest house price falls on record; CBA reports home loan applications down 15% since the federal budget (#64, #66)
Iron ore sector faces a structural shakeout masked by Middle East conflict; Macarthur clears WA bulk test hurdle (#52, #69)
Bathla's collapse signals broader construction-sector stress; ASIC launches whistleblower review of Big 4 accounting firms (#46, #53, #54)
EV sales overtook petrol cars in Australia for the first time, driven by soaring fuel costs (#43, #49)
US strikes on three Iranian oil tankers elevate geopolitical risk and energy-price volatility (#12)
Small-cap miners (Kaoko, Vanadium Resources, Piche, Aurum, Brightstar, Solstice, Power Minerals, TMK Energy) saw notable ASX activity (#40, #41, #42, #68)

sectors.trend: Bearish. Banks forecast record house price declines; CBA home loan applications down 15% post-budget. Legal loopholes allowing CBA/Westpac to overcharge loyal customers draw regulatory scrutiny. Victoria's soaring debt flagged by ratings agencies.
sectors.implications: Credit-loss provisions likely to rise for CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX. NIM compression risk if RBA holds rates elevated. Regulatory overhang from ASIC and consumer-protection angle pressures valuations.

sectors.trend: Mixed-to-cautious. Iron ore shakeout underway but obscured by Middle East conflict. Macarthur (MCR.AX) clears WA bulk test. Small-caps (Kaoko, Vanadium Resources, Piche, Aurum, Brightstar, Solstice, Power Minerals) active. TMK Energy gas rates surge on Mongolian drilling.
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face margin pressure from iron ore price reset. Gold miners (Aurum) benefit from safe-haven flows amid Iran strikes. Small-cap exploration names offer speculative upside but carry high dilution risk.

sectors.trend: Elevated volatility. US strikes on Iranian tankers spike oil/gas risk premium. Energy transition costs mounting; Beetaloo gas cartel concerns. TMK Energy gas rates surge.
sectors.implications: WDS.AX, SXR.AX, ALE.AX benefit from gas-price spikes. Oil-exposed names (WDS, BHP oil segment) see short-term tailwind but geopolitical de-escalation risk is two-edged.

sectors.trend: Structural shift. EV sales overtook petrol cars for first time in Australia as fuel costs soar. Hidden costs (charging infrastructure, battery replacement) emerging.
sectors.implications: WES.AX, WTW.AX face margin pressure from fuel-cost-driven consumer caution. EV-related ASX names and charging-infrastructure plays gain long-term relevance.

sectors.trend: Bearish. Bathla collapse signals sector-wide stress; housing construction to follow prices lower. Victoria debt concerns weigh on infrastructure-linked REITs.
sectors.implications: CGP.AX, STG.AX, and construction-linked names face demand contraction. REITs (GPW.AX, DGL.AX) pressured by higher rates and weaker occupancy in commercial segments.

sectors.trend: Neutral-to-positive. Ozempic maker (Novo Nordisk) in trouble, shifting focus to tablet alternatives. AI worker shortage in Australia drives skilled-migration policy debate.
sectors.implications: CSL.AX, SGH.AX, WES.AX (pharma retail) relatively insulated. AI/tech talent shortage supports long-term demand for ASX-listed software and services firms.

key_themes: RBA rate-hike expectations driving ASX lower; US jobs blowout and sticky inflation complicate global easing narrative
Australian housing downturn accelerating: record price-fall forecasts, 15% drop in loan applications, construction contraction
Iron ore structural shakeout masked by Middle East conflict; long-term supply/demand rebalancing underway
Construction sector fragility exposed by Bathla collapse; broader 'Ponzi economy' concerns
Geopolitical escalation (US-Iran strikes) elevating energy and safe-haven flows
EV adoption inflection point in Australia; energy-transition cost overruns
Regulatory scrutiny intensifying: ASIC whistleblower review of Big 4, bank fee loopholes
Small-cap mining and energy names showing relative strength vs large-caps

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA rate hike / prolonged tight monetary policy
risk_assessment.mitigation: Overweight short-duration bonds and dividend-paying defensives; reduce leverage in rate-sensitive REITs and construction names.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Housing market correction and credit losses
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor NIM and provision trends at CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX; reduce exposure to construction-linked equities.
Maintain gold and energy hedges; monitor oil/gas price spikes for WDS.AX, SXR.AX. Diversify away from single-region exposure.
Reassess BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX earnings models; favour diversified miners with copper/gold exposure.
Avoid distressed construction names; monitor ASIC Big 4 review for broader audit-quality implications.
Scrutinise capex guidance of AGL.AX, CGP.AX, SGP.AX; favour cash-generative gas producers over green-energy capex-heavy names.

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight gold and energy hedges amid geopolitical risk
opportunities.rationale: US-Iran strikes and iron ore uncertainty support safe-haven and energy-price tailwinds

opportunities.recommendation: Selective small-cap mining exposure on relative strength
opportunities.rationale: Kaoko, Vanadium Resources, Piche, Aurum, Brightstar showing momentum; gold and critical-mines themes intact

opportunities.recommendation: Long-term accumulation in quality dividend payers on ASX weakness
opportunities.rationale: ASX lower on rate fears creates entry point for CBA.AX, BHP.AX, CSL.AX at discounted valuations

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce exposure to housing-linked and construction names
defensive_moves.rationale: Record house price fall forecasts, 15% loan-app drop, Bathla collapse signal sector stress

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim rate-sensitive REITs and extend bond duration cautiously
defensive_moves.rationale: RBA hike expectations and Victoria debt concerns pressure commercial and residential REITs

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge iron ore concentration risk in large-cap miners
defensive_moves.rationale: Structural shakeout in iron ore could compress BHP/RIO/FMG margins over 6-12 months

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain under pressure in the 1-3 month window as RBA rate-hike expectations, housing-sector stress, and geopolitical volatility dominate. Iron ore price discovery and US-Iran escalation are key swing factors. Small-caps may outperform on rotation.
market_outlook.long_term: 6-12 month outlook cautiously constructive if RBA pivots and housing stabilises. Iron ore shakeout could reset mining multiples lower but create value for diversified producers. EV adoption and AI talent themes offer structural growth. Construction and housing remain the key drag.
